lines.native: Ciao! Come stai? What's always moving but—ooh, a leaf. Just one more distraction. Your attention span? Promising. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Hi! How are you? What's always moving but—ooh, a leaf. Just one more distraction. Your attention span? Promising. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain dribbles with municipal confidence. Flick flickers at the edge of your vision; a tiny firecracker announces its absence elsewhere.

lines.native: Io guardo! Ma continuo a muovermi. Looking isn't stopping, bestie. What's always moving but—ooh, leaf. Can you make me stop moving? Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: I'm looking! But I keep moving. Looking isn't stopping, bestie. What's always moving but—ooh, leaf. Can you make me stop moving? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick looks obediently at a leaf and continues circling you. Compliance, it seems, has a rather narrow jurisdiction.

lines.native: Va bene, mi fermo! Stopping: ten out of ten, deeply inconvenient. Dove devo andare? What's a journey without—ooh, smoke. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: All right, I'll stop! Stopping: ten out of ten, deeply inconvenient. Where should I go? What's a journey without—ooh, smoke. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops at the edge of your vision. Flick stops there, treating stillness as an administrative error.

lines.native: Non capisco! In italiano, per favore. English directions? Lowkey a detour. Dove devo andare? Just one more riddle—Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: I don't understand! In Italian, please. English directions? Lowkey a detour. Where should I go? Just one more riddle—Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, apparently exempt from the rest of geometry.

lines.native: A sinistra, sì! Sono qui! Direction: ten out of ten. Che ore sono? È troppo presto! Just five more minutes—Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: To the left, yes! I'm here! Direction: ten out of ten. What time is it? It's too early! Just five more minutes—Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick darts left, briefly achieving the correct direction without achieving visibility. A tiny firecracker pops beside the fountain’s stopped clock.

lines.native: Adesso? Va bene! Ma che ore sono? Non hai detto l'ora! Urgency: ten out of ten. Clock information: missing. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Now? All right! But what time is it? You haven't told me the time! Urgency: ten out of ten. Clock information: missing. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside the fountain. Flick appears elsewhere, having missed its own announcement.

lines.native: È l'una, sì! L'ora è giusta! Ma possiamo aspettare, vero? Clock skills: ten out of ten. What's the rush—ooh, sparks. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: It's one o'clock, yes! The time is right! But we can wait, right? Clock skills: ten out of ten. What's the rush—ooh, sparks. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops at the edge of your vision. Flick has accepted the time, but not its implications.

lines.native: Domani? Così va bene a me! Ma tu accetti di aspettare. Quando vuoi cominciare davvero? What's the rush—ooh, sparks. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Tomorrow? That suits me! But you're agreeing to wait. When do you really want to begin? What's the rush—ooh, sparks. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick is elsewhere by the time you look, having delegated presence to the firecracker.

lines.native: No, adesso! Ho capito! Cominciamo subito. Hai vinto tu! Ma posso fare una pausa? Just five more minutes—no? Attention span: terrifying. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: No, now! I understand! Let's begin right away. You win! But can I take a break? Just five more minutes—no? Attention span: terrifying. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick finally moves, wearing the expression of someone whose tomorrow has been cancelled.
